{{Top|leg}}
A '''proton mine''' was a space-based defensive weapon. Hundreds of proton mines were deployed around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oon Tien]] to protect the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in orbit.
